---
title: "Multiclass Classification on the Iris Dataset"
description: "A case study in classifying Iris species from flower measurements: EDA, feature engineering, and model comparison, published via Quarto."
---

## Overview

This project develops a case study in multiclass classification using the classic Iris flower dataset.

Rather than focusing solely on predictive performance, the project emphasizes the full classification workflow: exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and rigorous comparison of multiple models through cross-validation.

The final objective is to identify which measurements best separate the three Iris species and which model classifies them most reliably.

---

## Problem Statement

Given sepal and petal measurements for an Iris flower, the system must:

1. Explore and understand the dataset.
2. Engineer and evaluate additional predictive features.
3. Train and compare multiple classification models.
4. Predict the species for unseen observations.

---

## Methodology

The project follows a structured machine learning pipeline:

* Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
* Feature engineering (derived measurements, dimensionality reduction for visualization)
* Feature scaling
* Baseline and comparison models
* Logistic Regression
* K-Nearest Neighbors
* Decision Tree
* Random Forest
* Support Vector Machine
* Cross-validation and model comparison
* Final model selection and evaluation

---

## Dataset

The project uses the **Iris Flower Dataset** from Kaggle.

The dataset contains sepal and petal measurements for 150 Iris flowers, evenly split across three species:

* Sepal length and width (cm)
* Petal length and width (cm)
* Species: Iris-setosa, Iris-versicolor, Iris-virginica

The objective is to predict species from the four measurements.

## Project Structure

The repository is organized as follows:

```text
kaggle-iris/
│
├── README.md                                   # Project overview and usage instructions.
├── index.qmd                                    # Landing page for the Quarto website.
├── _quarto.yml                                  # Quarto website configuration.
├── environment.yml                              # Conda environment specification.
├── LICENSE                                      # Project license.
│
├── scripts/
│   └── publish.sh                               # Executes notebooks and publishes the site to GitHub Pages.
│
├── notebooks/
│   ├── 01_eda_and_feature_engineering.ipynb     # Exploratory data analysis (EDA) and feature engineering.
│   └── 02_modeling_and_evaluation.ipynb         # Model training, comparison, and evaluation.
│
├── data/
│   ├── raw/
│   │   └── IRIS.csv                             # Kaggle Iris dataset.
│   │
│   └── processed/
│       ├── data.parquet                         # Dataset produced after EDA and feature engineering.
│       ├── features.parquet                     # Feature matrix used for modeling.
│       └── predictions.csv                      # Final predictions and evaluation outputs.
│
└── _site/
    └── ...                                      # Website generated by Quarto (gitignored - published via scripts/publish.sh, not committed).
```

The site is published to GitHub Pages by running `scripts/publish.sh`, which executes the notebooks and then runs `quarto publish gh-pages`.
